-- Tower of Hanoi Implementation in Lua
-- This demonstrates the basic algorithm for the Tower of Hanoi puzzle
-- where you move n disks from the left peg to the right peg using two pegs as intermediate

local function move(peg, target, from, count)
    -- Check if peg is valid
    if peg == "left" then
        if count == 0 then
            target = "right"
        else
            return move(from, target, "left", count - 1)
        end
    else
        if count == 0 then
            target = "left"
        else
            return move(peg, target, from, count - 1)
        end
    end
end

-- Tower of Hanoi with 3 pegs
local function tower_of_hanoi(peg1, peg2, peg3, n)
    if n <= 0 then
        print("Empty peg")
        return
    end
    
    local temp = peg2
    local result = {temp, peg1, peg2, peg3, n, count}
    
    -- Move n-1 disks from peg1 to peg2
    if n > 0 then
        local peg_to_move = peg3
        local peg_from = peg1
        local peg_to_dest = peg2
        move(peg_to_move, peg_to_dest, peg_from, n - 1)
    end
    
    -- Move n disks from peg1 to peg2
    move(peg1, peg2, peg3, 1)
    
    -- Move remaining n-1 disks from peg2 to peg1
    move(peg2, peg1, peg3, n - 1)
end
